# Overview

This document contains the analysis of ActLumus light exposure data for all participants in the AfterGlow study.

Definition of Time Periods

Study Phases

Pre-Ambulatory Period - Start: Monday at agreed upon wake-time - End: Monday of first in-laboratory day at agreed upon wake-time - Duration: 7 days

In-Laboratory Period - Start: Monday of first in-laboratory day, 1 minute after agreed upon wake-time - End: Next morning after last in-laboratory day at agreed upon wake-time - Duration: 10-13 days (varies by group)

Post-Ambulatory Period - Start: Next morning after last in-laboratory day, 1 minute after agreed upon wake-time - End: 7 days after start of this phase at agreed upon wake-time - Duration: 7 days

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Daily Phases

Wake - Timeframe: Agreed upon wake-time until 3 hours prior to HBT

Pre-Sleep - Timeframe: 3 hours before HBT 

Sleep - Timeframe: HBT until agreed upon wake-time

------------------------------------------------------------------------

In-Laboratory Day Phases

During in-laboratory days, additional phases are defined for time spent in different locations:

-   Lab (Outside Chamber): First hour of arrival (HBT-6.5h to HBT-5.5h)
-   Lab (Inside Chamber): 5 hours of controlled light exposure (HBT-5.5h to HBT-0.5h)
    -   Dim 1: HBT-5.5h to HBT-3.0h (3 hours at 10 lx)
    -   Intervention: HBT-3.0h to HBT-1.5h (1.5 hours at 10 lx or 1000 lx)
    -   Dim 2: HBT-1.5h to HBT-0.5h (0.5 hours at 10 lx)
-   Commute: 30 minutes to return home (HBT-0.5h to HBT)

# Setup and Bathroom Breaks Definition

```{r}
# Load packages
library(LightLogR)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
library(gt)

# Load metadata
metadata <- read_excel("C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/group/metadata/01_metadata_20250831T100000.xlsx")

# Extract and clean bathroom breaks for all participants
bathroom_breaks <- metadata %>%
  filter(`participant-id` != "P11") %>%  # Exclude P11 (study dropout)
  select(`participant-id`, date, `scenario-code`, starts_with("bathroom")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("bathroom"), names_to = "break_number", values_to = "break_time") %>%
  filter(!is.na(break_time)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Remove trailing punctuation
    break_time = str_remove(break_time, "[?!]+$"),
    # Standardize separators to "-"
    break_time = str_replace_all(break_time, "[_;=]", "-"),
    break_time = str_replace_all(break_time, "_", ":"),
    # Fix cases with 3 colons (e.g., "21:15:22:19" -> "21:15-22:19")
    break_time = if_else(
      str_count(break_time, ":") == 3,
      str_replace(break_time, "^([0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}):([0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2})$", "\\1-\\2"),
      break_time
    ),
    # P07 Fix 1: 21:16-21-20 -> 21:16-21:20 (2025-07-30)
    break_time = if_else(
      `participant-id` == "P07" & date == as.Date("2025-07-30") & break_time == "21:16-21-20",
      "21:16-21:20",
      break_time
    ),
    # P07 Fix 2: 22-33-22:36 -> 22:33-22:36 (2025-08-02)
    break_time = if_else(
      `participant-id` == "P07" & date == as.Date("2025-08-02") & break_time == "22-33-22:36",
      "22:33-22:36",
      break_time
    ),
    # P10 Fix 1: 21:15-22:19 -> 22:15-22:19 (2025-08-16)
    break_time = if_else(
      `participant-id` == "P10" & date == as.Date("2025-08-16") & break_time == "21:15-22:19",
      "22:15-22:19",
      break_time
    ),
    # P10 Fix 2: 21.47 -> 21:47 (dot to colon, 2025-08-12)
    break_time = str_replace(break_time, "21\\.47", "21:47")
  ) %>%
  separate(break_time, into = c("start_time", "end_time"), sep = "-", extra = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    start_time = str_trim(start_time),
    end_time = str_trim(end_time),
    start_datetime = ymd_hm(paste(as.Date(date), start_time), tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
    end_datetime = ymd_hm(paste(as.Date(date), end_time), tz = "Europe/Berlin")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_datetime), !is.na(end_datetime)) %>%
  select(participant_id = `participant-id`, start_datetime, end_datetime)

# Check: Count bathroom breaks per participant

bathroom_breaks %>%
  count(participant_id, name = "n_breaks") %>%
  arrange(participant_id)
```

# Participant Analyses

# P01 - ActLumus data import and analysis

P01 Information:

-   Group 1, HBT: 00:00 (midnight)

-   Light Sequence: DDDBBBDDBDB (11 sessions: 6 D, 5 B)

## P01 data import and preprocessing

```{r}
# Import ActLumus data with timezone and participant ID
filename <- "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P01/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250707T180400.txt"
light_P01 <- import$ActLumus(filename, tz = "Europe/Berlin", manual.id = "P01")

# Check data quality
light_P01 |> has_irregulars()
light_P01 |> has_gaps()

# Round to minutes using floor
light_P01 <- light_P01 |> 
  aggregate_Datetime(unit = "1 min", type = "floor")

```

## P01 Time period definitions

```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory: 09.06 08:30 - 16.06 08:30
pre_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-09 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
pre_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Laboratory: 16.06 08:31 - 27.06 08:30
lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Post-Ambulatory: 27.06 08:31 - 04.07 08:30
post_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
post_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-07-04 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
```

## P01 pre-ambulatory analysis

```{r}
# Filter to Pre-Ambulatory period
pre_amb_data <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= pre_amb_start, Datetime <= pre_amb_end) |> 
  mutate(
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour(Datetime) >= 8.5 & hour(Datetime) < 21 ~ "Wake",
      hour(Datetime) >= 21 | hour(Datetime) < 0 ~ "Pre-Sleep",
      hour(Datetime) >= 0 & hour(Datetime) < 8.5 ~ "Sleep",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Subphase))

# Calculate statistics for each subphase
pre_amb_stats <- pre_amb_data |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pre_amb_stats)
```

## P01 extract individual metrics as variables

```{r}
# Wake metrics
mean_lux_preamb_wake_P01 <- pre_amb_stats |> filter(Subphase == "Wake") |> pull(mean_lux)
median_lux_preamb_wake_P01 <- pre_amb_stats |> filter(Subphase == "Wake") |> pull(median_lux)
median_log_lux_preamb_wake_P01 <- pre_amb_stats |> filter(Subphase == "Wake") |> pull(median_log_lux)
```

## P01 laboraotry analysis

```{r}
# Get P01 bathroom breaks from central dataframe
p01_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P01")

# Verify bathroom breaks count
cat("Bathroom breaks captured for P01:", nrow(p01_bathroom), "\n")

# Assign light conditions (DDDBBBDDBDB - 11 days total)
light_condition_P01 <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

# Get unique lab dates
lab_dates <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

# Create lookup table
lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
  Date = lab_dates, 
  Condition = light_condition_P01[1:length(lab_dates)]
)

# Process laboratory data with subphases
lab_data <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    # Define subphases
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 0 & hour_dec < 8.5 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 8.5 & hour_dec < 17.5 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 17.5 & hour_dec < 18.5 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 0 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Define chamber phases for bright days
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 21.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 21.5 & hour_dec < 23.0 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 23.0 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Flag bathroom breaks using central bathroom_breaks dataframe
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p01_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p01_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## P01 calculate dim days statistics (6 days)

```{r}
lab_dim_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "D", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase)) |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 6,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 6,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(lab_dim_stats)
```

## P01 calculate bright days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
# Non-chamber phases
lab_bright_nonchamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase), Subphase != "Lab (Inside Chamber)") |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Chamber phases
lab_bright_chamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Chamber_Phase)) |> 
  group_by(Chamber_Phase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  rename(Subphase = Chamber_Phase)

# Combine bright stats
lab_bright_stats <- bind_rows(lab_bright_nonchamber_stats, lab_bright_chamber_stats)

print(lab_bright_stats)
```

# P02 - ActLumus data import and analysis

P02 information:

-   Light Sequence: DDDBBBDDBDB (11 sessions: 6 D, 5 B)

## P02 data import & preprocessing

```{r}
# Import ActLumus data with timezone and participant ID
filename <- "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P02/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250704T140100.txt"
light_P02 <- import$ActLumus(filename, tz = "Europe/Berlin", manual.id = "P02")

# Check data quality
light_P02 |> has_irregulars()
light_P02 |> has_gaps()

# Round to minutes using floor
light_P02 <- light_P02 |> 
  aggregate_Datetime(unit = "1 min", type = "floor")
```

## P02 define time periods

```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory: 09.06 08:30 - 16.06 08:30
pre_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-09 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
pre_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Laboratory: 16.06 08:31 - 27.06 08:30
lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Post-Ambulatory: 27.06 08:31 - 04.07 08:30
post_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
post_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-07-04 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
```

## P02 pre-ambulatory analysis

```{r}
pre_amb_data <- light_P02 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= pre_amb_start, Datetime <= pre_amb_end) |> 
  mutate(
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour(Datetime) >= 8.5 & hour(Datetime) < 21 ~ "Wake",
      hour(Datetime) >= 21 | hour(Datetime) < 0 ~ "Pre-Sleep",
      hour(Datetime) >= 0 & hour(Datetime) < 8.5 ~ "Sleep",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Subphase))

pre_amb_stats <- pre_amb_data |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pre_amb_stats)
```

## P02 laboratory analysis

```{r}
# Get P02 bathroom breaks from central dataframe
p02_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P02")

# Verify bathroom breaks count
cat("Bathroom breaks captured for P02:", nrow(p02_bathroom), "\n")

# Assign light conditions (DDDBBBDDBDB - 11 days total)
light_condition_P02 <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

# Get unique lab dates
lab_dates <- light_P02 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

# Create lookup table
lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
  Date = lab_dates, 
  Condition = light_condition_P02[1:length(lab_dates)]
)

# Process laboratory data with subphases
lab_data <- light_P02 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 0 & hour_dec < 8.5 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 8.5 & hour_dec < 17.5 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 17.5 & hour_dec < 18.5 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 0 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 21.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 21.5 & hour_dec < 23.0 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 23.0 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Flag bathroom breaks using central bathroom_breaks dataframe
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p02_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p02_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## P02 calculate dim days statistics (6 days)

```{r}
lab_dim_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "D", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase)) |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 6,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 6,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(lab_dim_stats)
```

```{r}

  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

lab_bright_chamber_stats <- lab_data |>

  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  rename(Subphase = Chamber_Phase)

lab_bright_stats <- bind_rows(lab_bright_nonchamber_stats, lab_bright_chamber_stats)

print(lab_bright_stats)
```

```{r}
# Import ActLumus data with timezone and participant ID
filename <- "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P04/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250717T140700.txt"
light_P04 <- import$ActLumus(filename, tz = "Europe/Berlin", manual.id = "P04")

# Check data quality
light_P04 |> has_irregulars()
light_P04 |> has_gaps()

# Round to minutes using floor
light_P04 <- light_P04 |> 
  aggregate_Datetime(unit = "1 min", type = "floor")
```

## P04 define time periods

```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory: 23.06 07:00 - 30.06 07:00
pre_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-23 07:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
pre_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-30 07:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Laboratory: 30.06 07:01 - 10.07 07:00
lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-30 07:01", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-07-10 07:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Post-Ambulatory: 10.07 07:01 - 17.07 07:00
post_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-07-10 07:01", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
post_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-07-17 07:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
```

## P04 pre-ambulatory analysis

```{r}
pre_amb_data <- light_P04 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= pre_amb_start, Datetime <= pre_amb_end) |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 7 & hour_dec < 19 ~ "Wake",
      hour_dec >= 19 & hour_dec < 22 ~ "Pre-Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 22 | hour_dec < 7 ~ "Sleep",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Subphase))

pre_amb_stats <- pre_amb_data |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pre_amb_stats)
```

## P04 laboratory analysis

```{r}
# Get P04 bathroom breaks from central dataframe
p04_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P04")

# Verify bathroom breaks count
cat("Bathroom breaks captured for P04:", nrow(p04_bathroom), "\n")

# Assign light conditions: DBBBDDDBDB (10 days: 5 Dim, 5 Bright)
light_condition_P04 <- c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

lab_dates <- light_P04 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(Date = lab_dates, Condition = light_condition_P04[1:length(lab_dates)])

# Process laboratory data
lab_data <- light_P04 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 22 | hour_dec < 7 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 7 & hour_dec < 15.5 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 15.5 & hour_dec < 16.5 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 16.5 & hour_dec < 21.5 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 21.5 & hour_dec < 22 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 16.5 & hour_dec < 19.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 19.5 & hour_dec < 21.0 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 21.0 & hour_dec < 21.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Flag bathroom breaks using central bathroom_breaks dataframe
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p04_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p04_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## P04 calculate dim days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_dim_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "D", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase)) |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(lab_dim_stats)
```

## P04 calculate bright days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_bright_nonchamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase), Subphase != "Lab (Inside Chamber)") |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lab_bright_chamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Chamber_Phase)) |> 
  group_by(Chamber_Phase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  rename(Subphase = Chamber_Phase)

lab_bright_stats <- bind_rows(lab_bright_nonchamber_stats, lab_bright_chamber_stats)

print(lab_bright_stats)
```

# P06 - ActLumus data import and analysis

Information P06:

-   Group 3, HBT: 23:30

-   Light Sequence: DBBBDDDBDB (10 sessions: 5 D, 5 B)

-   Note: Multiple ActLumus files combined due to device resets (to avoid missing data or device malfunctions)

## P06 data import and preprocessing

```{r}
# Import and combine all ActLumus files for P06
files_P06 <- c(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250728T174400.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/02_actlumus_20250729T172800.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/03_actlumus_20250802T174500.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/04_actlumus_20250803T172400.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/05_actlumus_20250804T174200.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/06_actlumus_20250805T174000.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/07_actlumus_20250806T171900.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/08_actlumus_20250806T172100.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P06/continuous/actlumus/09_actlumus_20250814T225200.txt"
)

# Import all files and combine
light_P06_list <- lapply(files_P06, function(file) {
  import$ActLumus(file, tz = "Europe/Berlin", manual.id = "P06")
})

# Combine all datasets
light_P06 <- bind_rows(light_P06_list) |> 
  arrange(Datetime) |> 
  distinct(Datetime, .keep_all = TRUE) |>   # Remove any duplicate timestamps
  filter(Datetime >= ymd("2025-07-16"))     # Remove old test data from November 2024

# Check data quality
light_P06 |> has_irregulars()
light_P06 |> has_gaps()

# Round to minutes using floor
light_P06 <- light_P06 |> 
  aggregate_Datetime(unit = "1 min", type = "floor")
```


## P06 laboratory analysis

```{r}
# Get P06 bathroom breaks from central dataframe
p06_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P06")

# Verify bathroom breaks count
cat("Bathroom breaks captured for P06:", nrow(p06_bathroom), "\n")

# Assign light conditions: DBBBDDDBDB (10 days: 5 Dim, 5 Bright)
light_condition_P06 <- c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

lab_dates <- light_P06 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(Date = lab_dates, Condition = light_condition_P06[1:length(lab_dates)])

# Process laboratory data
lab_data <- light_P06 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 8.5 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 8.5 & hour_dec < 17 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 17 & hour_dec < 18 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 23 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 21 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 21 & hour_dec < 22.5 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 22.5 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Flag bathroom breaks using central bathroom_breaks dataframe
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p06_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p06_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## P06 calculate dim statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_dim_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "D", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase)) |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(lab_dim_stats)
```

## P06 calculate bright days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_bright_nonchamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase), Subphase != "Lab (Inside Chamber)") |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lab_bright_chamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Chamber_Phase)) |> 
  group_by(Chamber_Phase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  rename(Subphase = Chamber_Phase)

lab_bright_stats <- bind_rows(lab_bright_nonchamber_stats, lab_bright_chamber_stats)

print(lab_bright_stats)
```

# P07 - ActLumus data import and analysis

P07 information:

-   Group 3, HBT: 23:30

-   Light Sequence: DBBBDDDBDB (10 sessions: 5 D, 5 B)

-   NOTE: Multiple ActLumus files combined due to device resets (to avoid missing data or device malfunctions)

-   NOTE: Bathroom breaks use central bathroom_breaks dataframe with P07 fixes

## P07 data import and preprocessing

```{r}
# Import and combine all ActLumus files for P07
files_P07 <- c(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250728T173300.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/02_actlumus_20250729T172500.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/03_actlumus_20250802T174200.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/04_actlumus_20250803T172600.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/05_actlumus_20250804T173900.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/06_actlumus_20250805T174200.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/07_actlumus_20250806T172300.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P07/continuous/actlumus/08_actlumus_20250814T225200.txt"
)

# Import all files and combine
light_P07_list <- lapply(files_P07, function(file) {
  import$ActLumus(file, tz = "Europe/Berlin", manual.id = "P07")
})

# Combine all datasets
light_P07 <- bind_rows(light_P07_list) |> 
  arrange(Datetime) |> 
  distinct(Datetime, .keep_all = TRUE) |>   # Remove any duplicate timestamps
  filter(Datetime >= ymd("2025-07-16"))     # Remove old test data if any

# Check data quality
light_P07 |> has_irregulars()
light_P07 |> has_gaps()

# Round to minutes using floor
light_P07 <- light_P07 |> 
  aggregate_Datetime(unit = "1 min", type = "floor")
```

## P07 define time periods

```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory: 21.07 07:30 - 28.07 07:30
pre_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-07-21 07:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
pre_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-07-28 07:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Laboratory: 28.07 07:31 - 07.08 07:30
lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-07-28 07:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-08-07 07:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Post-Ambulatory: 07.08 07:31 - 14.08 07:30
post_amb_start <- ymd_hm("2025-08-07 07:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
post_amb_end <- ymd_hm("2025-08-14 07:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
```

## P07 pre-ambulatory analysis

```{r}
pre_amb_data <- light_P07 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= pre_amb_start, Datetime <= pre_amb_end) |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 7.5 & hour_dec < 20.5 ~ "Wake",
      hour_dec >= 20.5 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Pre-Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 7.5 ~ "Sleep",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Subphase))

pre_amb_stats <- pre_amb_data |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pre_amb_stats)
```

## P07 extract pre-ambulatory metrics

```{r}
mean_lux_preamb_wake_P07 <- pre_amb_stats |> filter(Subphase == "Wake") |> pull(mean_lux)
median_lux_preamb_wake_P07 <- pre_amb_stats |> filter(Subphase == "Wake") |> pull(median_lux)
median_log_lux_preamb_wake_P07 <- pre_amb_stats |> filter(Subphase == "Wake") |> pull(median_log_lux)
```

## P07 laboratory analysis

```{r}
# Get P07 bathroom breaks from central dataframe (with fixes already applied)
p07_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P07")

# Verify bathroom breaks count
cat("Bathroom breaks captured for P07:", nrow(p07_bathroom), "\n")

# Assign light conditions: DBBBDDDBDB (10 days: 5 Dim, 5 Bright)
light_condition_P07 <- c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

lab_dates <- light_P07 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(Date = lab_dates, Condition = light_condition_P07[1:length(lab_dates)])

# Process laboratory data
lab_data <- light_P07 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 7.5 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 7.5 & hour_dec < 17 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 17 & hour_dec < 18 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 23 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 21 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 21 & hour_dec < 22.5 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 22.5 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Flag bathroom breaks using central bathroom_breaks dataframe
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p07_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p07_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## P07 calculate dim days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_dim_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "D", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase)) |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(lab_dim_stats)
```

## P07 calculate bright days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_bright_nonchamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase), Subphase != "Lab (Inside Chamber)") |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lab_bright_chamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Chamber_Phase)) |> 
  group_by(Chamber_Phase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  rename(Subphase = Chamber_Phase)

lab_bright_stats <- bind_rows(lab_bright_nonchamber_stats, lab_bright_chamber_stats)

print(lab_bright_stats)
```

# P09 - ActLumus data import and analysis

P09 information:

-   Group 3, HBT: 23:30

-   Light Sequence: DBBBDDDBDB (10 sessions: 5 D, 5 B)

-   Complex device switch with P10 during study

-   Files combined from P09 and P10 directories based on actual device assignments

-   Bathroom breaks use central bathroom_breaks dataframe

## P09 data import with time filters

```{r}
# Part 1: P09 files BEFORE switch (complete files, unaffected)
files_P09_before <- c(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250728T175000.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/02_actlumus_20250729T173000.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/03_actlumus_20250802T173900.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/04_actlumus_20250803T172800.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/05_actlumus_20250804T174500.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/06_actlumus_20250805T174500.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/07_actlumus_20250806T172800.txt"
)

light_P09_before <- lapply(files_P09_before, function(file) {
  import$ActLumus(file, tz = "Europe/Berlin", manual.id = "P09")
}) |> bind_rows()

# Part 2: P10 file 01 - Gap period (06.08 17:30 - 09.08 14:15)
light_P09_gap <- import$ActLumus(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250812T165500.txt",
  tz = "Europe/Berlin",
  manual.id = "P09"
) |> 
  filter(Datetime >= ymd_hm("2025-08-06 17:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
         Datetime < ymd_hm("2025-08-09 14:15", tz = "Europe/Berlin"))

# Part 3: P10 file 02 - Switch period (09.08 14:15 - 12.08 16:55)
light_P09_switch <- import$ActLumus(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/02_actlumus_20250812T172400.txt",
  tz = "Europe/Berlin",
  manual.id = "P09"
) |> 
  filter(Datetime >= ymd_hm("2025-08-09 14:15", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
         Datetime <= ymd_hm("2025-08-12 16:55", tz = "Europe/Berlin"))

# Part 4: P09 file 08 AFTER switch (12.08 17:00 onwards)
light_P09_after <- import$ActLumus(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P09/continuous/actlumus/08_actlumus_20250814T170500.txt",
  tz = "Europe/Berlin",
  manual.id = "P09"
) |> 
  filter(Datetime >= ymd_hm("2025-08-12 17:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin"))

# Ccombine all parts
light_P09 <- bind_rows(
  light_P09_before,
  light_P09_gap,
  light_P09_switch,
  light_P09_after
) |> 
  arrange(Datetime) |> 
  distinct(Datetime, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(Datetime >= ymd("2025-07-16")) |> 
  aggregate_Datetime(unit = "1 min", type = "floor")

# Check data quality
light_P09 |> has_irregulars()
light_P09 |> has_gaps()
```

## P09 pre-ambulatory analysis

```{r}
pre_amb_data <- light_P09 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= pre_amb_start, Datetime <= pre_amb_end) |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 8 & hour_dec < 20.5 ~ "Wake",
      hour_dec >= 20.5 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Pre-Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 8 ~ "Sleep",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Subphase))

pre_amb_stats <- pre_amb_data |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pre_amb_stats)
```

## P09 laboratory analysis

```{r}
# Get P09 bathroom breaks from central dataframe
p09_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P09")

# Verify bathroom breaks count
cat("Bathroom breaks captured for P09:", nrow(p09_bathroom), "\n")

# Assign light conditions: DBBBDDDBDB (10 days: 5 Dim, 5 Bright)
light_condition_P09 <- c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

lab_dates <- light_P09 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(Date = lab_dates, Condition = light_condition_P09[1:length(lab_dates)])

# Process laboratory data
lab_data <- light_P09 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 8 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 8 & hour_dec < 17 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 17 & hour_dec < 18 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 23 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 21 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 21 & hour_dec < 22.5 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 22.5 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Flag bathroom breaks using central bathroom_breaks dataframe
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p09_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p09_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## P09 calculate dim days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_dim_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "D", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase)) |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(lab_dim_stats)
```

## P09 calculate bright days statistics (5 days)

```{r}
lab_bright_nonchamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase), Subphase != "Lab (Inside Chamber)") |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lab_bright_chamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Chamber_Phase)) |> 
  group_by(Chamber_Phase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  rename(Subphase = Chamber_Phase)

lab_bright_stats <- bind_rows(lab_bright_nonchamber_stats, lab_bright_chamber_stats)

print(lab_bright_stats)
```

# P10 - ActLumus data import and analysis

P10 information:

-   Group 4, HBT: 23:00

-   Light Sequence: DDDBDBBBDBDD (13 calendar dates, 12 valid sessions)

-   Critical: Session 5 (15.08.2025) EXCLUDED due to light automation malfunction

-   Complex device switch with P09 during study

-   Bathroom breaks use central bathroom_breaks dataframe with P10 fixes

## P10 data import with time filters

```{r}
# Part 1: Before switch (until 09.08 14:15)
light_P10_before <- import$ActLumus(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/02_actlumus_20250812T172400.txt",
  tz = "Europe/Berlin",
  manual.id = "P10"
) |> 
  filter(Datetime < ymd_hm("2025-08-09 14:15", tz = "Europe/Berlin"))

# Part 2: During switch (09.08 14:15 - 12.08 16:55)
# Note: This file has participant ID = P09 in file, but contains P10's light exposure
light_P10_switch <- import$ActLumus(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/01_actlumus_20250812T165500.txt",
  tz = "Europe/Berlin",
  manual.id = "P10"
) |> 
  filter(Datetime >= ymd_hm("2025-08-09 14:15", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
         Datetime <= ymd_hm("2025-08-12 16:55", tz = "Europe/Berlin"))

# Part 3: After switch - all remaining files (from 12.08 17:27 onwards)
files_P10_after <- c(
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/03_actlumus_20250813T163700.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/04_actlumus_20250814T164000.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/05_actlumus_20250816T164900.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/06_actlumus_20250818T171100.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/07_actlumus_20250819T165600.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/08_actlumus_20250820T165900.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/09_actlumus_20250821T165300.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/10_actlumus_20250822T165900.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/11_actlumus_20250823T170000.txt",
  "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/P10/continuous/actlumus/12_actlumus_20250902T105600.txt"
)

light_P10_after <- lapply(files_P10_after, function(file) {
  import$ActLumus(file, tz = "Europe/Berlin", manual.id = "P10")
}) |> bind_rows()

# Combine all parts
light_P10 <- bind_rows(
  light_P10_before,
  light_P10_switch,
  light_P10_after
) |> 
  arrange(Datetime) |> 
  distinct(Datetime, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(Datetime >= ymd("2025-07-16")) |> 
  aggregate_Datetime(unit = "1 min", type = "floor")

# Check data quality
light_P10 |> has_irregulars()
light_P10 |> has_gaps()
```

## P10 post-ambulatory analysis

```{r}
post_amb_data <- light_P10 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= post_amb_start, Datetime <= post_amb_end) |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 8 & hour_dec < 20 ~ "Wake",
      hour_dec >= 20 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Pre-Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 23 | hour_dec < 8 ~ "Sleep",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Subphase))

post_amb_stats <- post_amb_data |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / 7,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(post_amb_stats)
```

## P10 laboratory analysis with session 5 exclusion

```{r}
# Get P10 bathroom breaks from central dataframe (with fixes already applied)
p10_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P10")

# Verify bathroom breaks count
cat("Bathroom breaks captured for P10:", nrow(p10_bathroom), "\n")

# P10: 12 valid sessions 
# Session 5 (15.08) EXCLUDED due to light automation malfunction
lab_dates_all <- light_P10 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

# Create lookup with Session 5 (15.08) marked as EXCLUDED and 24.08 as PARTIAL
full_sequence <- c(
  "D",         # 11.08 - Session 1
  "D",         # 12.08 - Session 2
  "D",         # 13.08 - Session 3
  "B",         # 14.08 - Session 4
  "EXCLUDED",  # 15.08 - Session 5 EXCLUDED
  "D",         # 16.08 - Session 6
  "B",         # 17.08 - Session 7
  "B",         # 18.08 - Session 8
  "B",         # 19.08 - Session 9
  "D",         # 20.08 - Session 10
  "B",         # 21.08 - Session 11
  "D",         # 22.08 - Session 12
  "D",         # 23.08 - Session 13
  "PARTIAL"    # 24.08 - partial end day (not full session)
)

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
  Date = lab_dates_all,
  Condition = full_sequence
)

# Process laboratory data
lab_data <- light_P10 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  # EXCLUDE Session 5 (15.08) and partial day (24.08)
  filter(Condition != "EXCLUDED", Condition != "PARTIAL") |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 23 | hour_dec < 8 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 8 & hour_dec < 16.5 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 16.5 & hour_dec < 17.5 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 17.5 & hour_dec < 22.5 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 22.5 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 17.5 & hour_dec < 20.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 20.5 & hour_dec < 22.0 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 22.0 & hour_dec < 22.5 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Flag bathroom breaks using central bathroom_breaks dataframe
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p10_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p10_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )

# Count valid sessions
dim_days <- lab_data |> filter(Condition == "D") |> pull(Date) |> unique() |> length()
bright_days <- lab_data |> filter(Condition == "B") |> pull(Date) |> unique() |> length()

cat("\n=== P10 LABORATORY SESSIONS ===\n")
cat("Dim days:", dim_days, "\n")
cat("Bright days:", bright_days, "\n")
cat("Total valid sessions:", dim_days + bright_days, "(Session 5 excluded)\n\n")
```

## P10 calculate dim days statistics

```{r}
lab_dim_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "D", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase)) |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / dim_days,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / dim_days,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(lab_dim_stats)
```

## P10 calculate bright days statistics

```{r}
lab_bright_nonchamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Subphase), Subphase != "Lab (Inside Chamber)") |> 
  group_by(Subphase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / bright_days,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / bright_days,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lab_bright_chamber_stats <- lab_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B", !is_bathroom_break, !is.na(Chamber_Phase)) |> 
  group_by(Chamber_Phase) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_lux = median(log10(MEDI[MEDI > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
    time_above_10lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 10, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / bright_days,
    time_above_250lx = as.numeric(duration_above_threshold(MEDI, Datetime, "above", 250, "1 min", na.rm = TRUE), units = "hours") / bright_days,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  rename(Subphase = Chamber_Phase)

lab_bright_stats <- bind_rows(lab_bright_nonchamber_stats, lab_bright_chamber_stats)

print(lab_bright_stats)
```

### Summary Statistics Lab, dim only

```{r}
# Exclusion of participant P07 due to negative melatonin suppression by bright light
# Different number of Dim Days across participants -> balanced out, so every participant has same weight 

# Define number of dim days per participant
n_sessions <- list(
  P01 = 6,
  P02 = 6,
  P04 = 5,
  P06 = 5,
  P09 = 5,
  P10 = 7
)

# Helper function for weighted mean
weighted_mean_metric <- function(values, participants, n_sessions) {
  weights <- unlist(n_sessions[participants])
  sum(values * weights) / sum(weights)
}
```

# Grand average plot: pre-ambulatory light exposure relative to HBT

What the plot shows: - X-axis: Hours relative to HBT (ranging from -12h to +12h, covering a full 24h cycle) \* 0h = HBT (marked with red dashed line) \* Negative values = hours BEFORE bedtime \* Positive values = hours AFTER bedtime - Y-axis: Light exposure in lux (log10 scale) - Blue line: Grand average light exposure across all 6 participants - Shaded ribbon: ±1 SD representing between-subject variability

Data calculation process:

1.  Time alignment: Each participant's clock time is converted to "hours from HBT" using their individual HBT (P01/P02: 00:00, P04: 22:00, P06/P07/P09: 23:30, P10: 23:00)

2.  Temporal binning: Data are binned into 5-minute intervals (0.083h) to align all participants to common timepoints, as raw data occur at slightly different times

3.  Participant averaging: For each 5-min bin, the mean lux value is calculated across all minutes within that bin for each participant (averaged over 7 days)

4.  Grand averaging: For each timepoint, the mean and SD are calculated across the 6 participant averages (not across individual data points)

Binning explanation: Raw data are collected minute-by-minute, but each participant's data points occur at slightly different decimal times (e.g., -11.983h vs -11.975h). To compute a meaningful grand average, we round all timepoints to the nearest 5-minute interval (e.g., both -11.983 and -11.975 round to -12.0). This ensures all 6 participants contribute data at exactly the same timepoints, enabling proper averaging. Formula: round(hours_from_hbt \* 12) / 12

Interpretation: Each point on the curve represents the average light exposure at that circadian timepoint, pooling data from all 7 participants across all 7 days of the pre-ambulatory period (total: 49 participant-days per timepoint).

## Step 1: define HBT for each participant

```{r}
participant_info <- tibble(
  participant = c("P01", "P02", "P04", "P06", "P09", "P10"),
  hbt_decimal = c(0, 0, 22, 23.5, 23.5, 23)  # HBT in decimal hours
)
```

## Step 2: function to convert clock time to hours relative to HBT

```{r}
time_relative_to_hbt <- function(clock_hour, hbt) {
  rel_time <- clock_hour - hbt
  # Wrap around 24h: keep in range -12 to +12
  if_else(rel_time > 12, rel_time - 24, 
          if_else(rel_time < -12, rel_time + 24, rel_time))
}
```

## Step 3: align each participant´s data to their HBT

```{r}
align_to_hbt <- function(light_data, participant_id, hbt, pre_start, pre_end) {
  light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= pre_start, Datetime <= pre_end) |> 
    mutate(
      hour_decimal = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
      hours_from_hbt = time_relative_to_hbt(hour_decimal, hbt),
      participant = participant_id
    ) |> 
    select(participant, Datetime, hours_from_hbt, MEDI)
}

# Align P01
p01_aligned <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P01, "P01", 0,
  ymd_hm("2025-06-09 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P02
p02_aligned <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P02, "P02", 0,
  ymd_hm("2025-06-09 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P04
p04_aligned <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P04, "P04", 22,
  ymd_hm("2025-06-23 07:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-06-30 07:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P06
p06_aligned <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P06, "P06", 23.5,
  ymd_hm("2025-07-21 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-07-28 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P09
p09_aligned <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P09, "P09", 23.5,
  ymd_hm("2025-07-21 08:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-07-28 08:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P10
p10_aligned <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P10, "P10", 23,
  ymd_hm("2025-08-04 08:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-08-11 08:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)
```

## Step 4: combine all participants

```{r}
all_aligned <- bind_rows(
  p01_aligned, p02_aligned, p04_aligned,
  p06_aligned, p09_aligned, p10_aligned
)
```

## Step 5: calculate participant averages (with 5-minute rounding)

```{r}
participant_averages <- all_aligned |> 
  mutate(
    hours_from_hbt_rounded = round(hours_from_hbt * 12) / 12  # Round to nearest 5 min
  ) |> 
  group_by(participant, hours_from_hbt_rounded) |> 
  summarise(
    participant_mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Step 6: calculate grand average across participants

```{r}
grand_avg_data <- participant_averages |> 
  group_by(hours_from_hbt_rounded) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_lux = sd(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_lux = sd(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_participants = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  filter(hours_from_hbt_rounded >= -12, hours_from_hbt_rounded <= 12)
```

## Step 7: create the plot (pre-ambulatory phase)

```{r}
#| label: fig-actlumus-grand-average-pre
#| fig-cap: "Grand average light exposure - pre-ambulatory phase"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

ggplot(grand_avg_data, aes(x = hours_from_hbt_rounded, y = mean_lux)) +
  
  # Black grand average line
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Grey shaded ribbon for ±1 SD
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_lux - sd_lux, ymax = mean_lux + sd_lux),
    alpha = 0.2, fill = "grey60"
  ) +
  
  # Grey dashed HBT line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # HBT label in grey
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = max(grand_avg_data$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
    label = "HBT",
    color = "grey40",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Log scale for light exposure
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  
  # X-axis: hours relative to HBT
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-12, 12, by = 3),
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), x, " h")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Grand average light exposure - pre-ambulatory phase",
    subtitle = "Grand average (P01, P02, P04, P06, P09, P10) aligned to habitual bedtime (HBT)",
    x = "Hours relative to HBT",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)",
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

# Grand average plot - post-ambulatory light exposure relative to HBT

## Step 1: time relative to HBT function (same as before)

```{r}
time_relative_to_hbt <- function(clock_hour, hbt) {
  rel_time <- clock_hour - hbt
  if_else(rel_time > 12, rel_time - 24, 
          if_else(rel_time < -12, rel_time + 24, rel_time))
}
```

## Step 2: align each participant´s post-ambulatory data

```{r}
align_to_hbt <- function(light_data, participant_id, hbt, post_start, post_end) {
  light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= post_start, Datetime <= post_end) |> 
    mutate(
      hour_decimal = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
      hours_from_hbt = time_relative_to_hbt(hour_decimal, hbt),
      participant = participant_id
    ) |> 
    select(participant, Datetime, hours_from_hbt, MEDI)
}

# Align P01 - Post-Ambulatory
p01_aligned_post <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P01, "P01", 0,
  ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-07-04 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P02 - Post-Ambulatory
p02_aligned_post <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P02, "P02", 0,
  ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-07-04 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P04 - Post-Ambulatory
p04_aligned_post <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P04, "P04", 22,
  ymd_hm("2025-07-10 07:01", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-07-17 07:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P06 - Post-Ambulatory
p06_aligned_post <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P06, "P06", 23.5,
  ymd_hm("2025-08-07 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-08-14 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P09 - Post-Ambulatory
p09_aligned_post <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P09, "P09", 23.5,
  ymd_hm("2025-08-07 08:01", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-08-14 08:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)

# Align P10 - Post-Ambulatory
p10_aligned_post <- align_to_hbt(
  light_P10, "P10", 23,
  ymd_hm("2025-08-24 08:01", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
  ymd_hm("2025-08-31 08:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
)
```

## Step 3: combine all participants

```{r}
all_aligned_post <- bind_rows(
  p01_aligned_post, p02_aligned_post, p04_aligned_post,
  p06_aligned_post, p09_aligned_post, p10_aligned_post
)
```

## Step 4: calculate participant averages (with 5-minute binning)

```{r}
participant_averages_post <- all_aligned_post |> 
  mutate(
    hours_from_hbt_rounded = round(hours_from_hbt * 12) / 12
  ) |> 
  group_by(participant, hours_from_hbt_rounded) |> 
  summarise(
    participant_mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Step 5: calculate grand average across participants

```{r}
grand_avg_data_post <- participant_averages_post |> 
  group_by(hours_from_hbt_rounded) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_lux = sd(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_lux = sd(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_participants = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  filter(hours_from_hbt_rounded >= -12, hours_from_hbt_rounded <= 12)
```

## Step 6: create the plot (post-ambulatory phase)

```{r}
#| label: fig-actlumus-grand-average-post
#| fig-cap: "Grand average light exposure - post-ambulatory phase"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

ggplot(grand_avg_data_post, aes(x = hours_from_hbt_rounded, y = mean_lux)) +
  
  # Black grand average line
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Grey shaded ribbon for ±1 SD
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_lux - sd_lux, ymax = mean_lux + sd_lux),
    alpha = 0.2, fill = "grey60"
  ) +
  
  # Grey dashed HBT line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # HBT label in grey
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = max(grand_avg_data_post$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
    label = "HBT",
    color = "grey40",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Log scale for light exposure
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  
  # X-axis: hours relative to HBT
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-12, 12, by = 3),
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), x, " h")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Grand average light exposure - post-ambulatory phase",
    subtitle = "Grand average (P01, P02, P04, P06, P09, P10) aligned to habitual bedtime (HBT)",
    x = "Hours relative to HBT",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)",
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

# Grand average plot - laboratory dim days light exposure relative to HBT

## Step 1: time relative to HBT function

```{r}
time_relative_to_hbt <- function(clock_hour, hbt) {
  rel_time <- clock_hour - hbt
  if_else(rel_time > 12, rel_time - 24, 
          if_else(rel_time < -12, rel_time + 24, rel_time))
}
```

## Step 2: align each participant´s lab dim data

```{r}
align_lab_dim_to_hbt <- function(light_data, participant_id, hbt, lab_start, lab_end, light_condition) {
  
  # Get lab dates
  lab_dates <- light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
    pull(Date) |> 
    unique() |> 
    sort()
  
  # Create lookup table
  lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
    Date = lab_dates,
    Condition = light_condition[1:length(lab_dates)]
  )
  
  # Filter for DIM days only and align to HBT
  light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
    left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
    filter(Condition == "D") |>  # ONLY DIM DAYS
    mutate(
      hour_decimal = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
      hours_from_hbt = time_relative_to_hbt(hour_decimal, hbt),
      participant = participant_id
    ) |> 
    select(participant, Datetime, hours_from_hbt, MEDI)
}
```

## Step 6: calculate weighted grand average

```{r}
# Weight by number of dim days per participant

n_dim_days <- c(P01 = 6, P02 = 6, P04 = 5, P06 = 5, P09 = 5, P10 = 7)

participant_averages_labdim <- participant_averages_labdim |> 
  mutate(weight = n_dim_days[participant])

grand_avg_data_labdim <- participant_averages_labdim |> 
  group_by(hours_from_hbt_rounded) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = weighted.mean(participant_mean_lux, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    # For SD, we use unweighted to show between-subject variability
    sd_lux = sd(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_lux = sd(participant_mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_participants = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  filter(hours_from_hbt_rounded >= -12, hours_from_hbt_rounded <= 12)
```

```{r}
  # Grey dashed HBT line

  # Grey shaded area for lab dim phase (-5h to -0.5h relative to HBT)
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -5, xmax = -0.5,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # Dashed borders for lab dim phase
  geom_vline(xintercept = -5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # HBT label
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = max(grand_avg_data_labdim$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,

    color = "grey40",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Lab dim label
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -2.75,
    y = max(grand_avg_data_labdim$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8,

    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Log scale for light exposure

    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), x, " h")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Grand average light exposure - laboratory dim days",
    subtitle = "Grand average (P01, P02, P04, P06, P09, P10) aligned to habitual bedtime (HBT)",
    x = "Hours relative to HBT",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)",
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
```

## Step 1: time relative to HBT function

```{r}
time_relative_to_hbt <- function(clock_hour, hbt) {
  rel_time <- clock_hour - hbt
  if_else(rel_time > 12, rel_time - 24, 
          if_else(rel_time < -12, rel_time + 24, rel_time))
}
```

## Step 2: align each participant´s lab bright data

```{r}
align_lab_bright_to_hbt <- function(light_data, participant_id, hbt, lab_start, lab_end, light_condition) {
  
  # Get lab dates
  lab_dates <- light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
    pull(Date) |> 
    unique() |> 
    sort()
  
  # Create lookup table
  lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
    Date = lab_dates,
    Condition = light_condition[1:length(lab_dates)]
  )
  
  # Filter for BRIGHT days only and align to HBT
  light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
    left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
    filter(Condition == "B") |>  # ONLY BRIGHT DAYS
    mutate(
      hour_decimal = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
      hours_from_hbt = time_relative_to_hbt(hour_decimal, hbt),
      participant = participant_id
    ) |> 
    select(participant, Datetime, hours_from_hbt, MEDI)
}
```

## Step 7: Create the plot (laboratory bright days) - adjusted phase boundaries

```{r}
#| label: fig-actlumus-grand-average-labbright
#| fig-cap: "Grand average light exposure - laboratory bright days"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

ggplot(grand_avg_data_labbright, aes(x = hours_from_hbt_rounded, y = mean_lux)) +
  
  # Black grand average line
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Grey ribbon for ±1 SD
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_lux - sd_lux, ymax = mean_lux + sd_lux),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "grey60") +
  
  # Dim light phase 1: -5.5h to -2.5h
  annotate("rect", xmin = -5.5, xmax = -2.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.3) +
  
  # Bright light phase: -2.5h to -1.0h
  annotate("rect", xmin = -2.5, xmax = -1.0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # Dim light phase 2: -1.0h to -0.5h
  annotate("rect", xmin = -1.0, xmax = -0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.3) +
  
  # Dashed vertical lines marking transitions and HBT
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-5.5, -2.5, -1.0, -0.5, 0),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  # Phase labels
  annotate("text", x = -4.0,
           y = max(grand_avg_data_labbright$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8,
           label = "D", color = "grey30", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = -1.75,
           y = max(grand_avg_data_labbright$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8,
           label = "B", color = "grey20", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.75,
           y = max(grand_avg_data_labbright$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8,
           label = "D", color = "grey30", size = 4) +
  
  # HBT label
  annotate("text", x = 0.5,
           y = max(grand_avg_data_labbright$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
           label = "HBT", color = "grey40", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  
  # Log scale for light exposure
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  
  # X-axis: hours relative to HBT
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-12, 12, by = 3),
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), x, " h")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Grand average light exposure - laboratory bright days",
    subtitle = "Grand average (P01, P02, P04, P06, P09, P10) aligned to habitual bedtime (HBT)",
    x = "Hours relative to HBT",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)",
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
