# Individual Participant Plots:

-   

    a)  Lab Evening Panels (relative to HBT)

-   

    b)  Boxplot for in-lab light and bathroom (dim vs. bright)

## Step 1: get bathroom breaks from central dataframe (P01)

```{r}
p01_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% 
  filter(participant_id == "P01")
```

## Step 2: prepare lab data with conditions (P01)

```{r}
# Laboratory period for P01
lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Light condition sequence (11 days: 6 D, 5 B)
light_condition_P01 <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

# Get lab dates
lab_dates <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

# Create condition lookup
lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
  Date = lab_dates, 
  Condition = light_condition_P01[1:length(lab_dates)]
)
```

## Step 3: process all lab data (P01)

```{r}
all_lab_data <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Datetime),
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60
  ) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    Day_label = paste0(format(Date, "%b %d"), " (", Condition, ")"),
    Day_label = factor(Day_label, levels = unique(Day_label)),
    in_bathroom = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p01_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p01_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## Step 4: prepare chamber data with hours prior to HBT (P01)

```{r}
# P01 Chamber timing (HBT 00:00):
# Entry: 18:30 (HBT-5.5h)
# Dim 1: 18:30-21:30 (3h)
# Bright: 21:30-23:00 (1.5h)
# Dim 2: 23:00-23:30 (0.5h)
# Exit: 23:30 (HBT-0.5h)

chamber_data <- all_lab_data |> 
  filter(hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 23.5) |> 
  mutate(hours_prior_HBT = hour_dec - 24)  # 0 = HBT

# Bright days only for vertical lines
bright_lines <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B") |> 
  distinct(Day_label) |> 
  mutate(
    xintercept_start = 21.5 - 24,  # Bright phase start relative to HBT
    xintercept_end   = 23 - 24     # Bright phase end relative to HBT
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(xintercept_start, xintercept_end),
    names_to = "phase", 
    values_to = "xintercept"
  )
```

## Step 5: create multi-panel plot (square panels) (P01)

```{r}
#| label: fig-actlumus-inchamber-p01
#| fig-cap: "In-chamber light exposure: all laboratory days - P01"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9

# Create evening labels matching melatonin style
chamber_data_plot <- chamber_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Get unique day order
    day_index = as.integer(factor(Day_label, levels = unique(Day_label))),
    # Detect light condition from Day_label (assumes "B" or "D" in brackets)
    light_cond = str_extract(Day_label, "(?<=\\()[BD](?=\\))"),
    evening_label = paste0("Evening ", day_index, " (", light_cond, ")")
  )

ggplot(chamber_data_plot, aes(x = hours_prior_HBT, y = MEDI + 1)) +
  
  # Bathroom shading
  geom_rect(
    data = chamber_data_plot |> filter(in_bathroom),
    aes(
      xmin = hours_prior_HBT - 0.017,
      xmax = hours_prior_HBT + 0.017,
      ymin = 1,
      ymax = 1000
    ),
    fill = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Bright-phase vertical lines only for bright days
  geom_vline(
    data = bright_lines,
    aes(xintercept = xintercept),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Light exposure line
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Facet by evening label
  facet_wrap(~evening_label, ncol = 4) +
  
  # X-axis in full hours prior HBT
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-6, 0, by = 1)
  ) +
  
  # Y-axis log scale up to 1000
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000),
    labels = scales::comma,
    limits = c(1, 1000),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "In-chamber light exposure: all laboratory days",
    subtitle = "P01 | 11 days (6 D, 5 B) | Gray shading: bathroom breaks | Dashed lines: bright phase",
    x = "Hours prior to HBT",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Step 6: Boxplot - light exposure distribution by chamber phase (P01)

```{r}
# Prepare data for boxplot (raw minute-by-minute data)
phase_data <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(in_bathroom == FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 21.5 ~ "Dim 1",
      hour_dec >= 21.5 & hour_dec < 23.0 ~ "Intervention",
      hour_dec >= 23.0 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Dim 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(phase))

# Bathroom break data
bathroom_data <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(in_bathroom == TRUE) |>
  mutate(phase = "Bathroom")

# Combine all data
combined_data <- bind_rows(phase_data, bathroom_data) |> 
  mutate(
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Dim 1", "Intervention", "Dim 2", "Bathroom")),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("D", "B"))
  )

# Define colors
light_colors <- c("D" = "#4A90E2", "B" = "#F5A623")

# Create boxplot
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = phase, y = MEDI + 1, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = light_colors,
    labels = c("D" = "D days", "B" = "B days")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Light exposure distribution by chamber phase",
    subtitle = "P01 | 11 days (6 D, 5 B) | Minute-by-minute raw data | Bathroom breaks shown separately",
    x = "Chamber phase",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)",
    fill = "Condition",
    caption = "Dim 1: 3h 10lx | Intervention: 1.5h | Dim 2: 0.5h 10lx | Bathroom: during breaks only"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top", 
    aspect.ratio = 1  # SQUARE FORMAT: Makes plot height = width
  )
```

# P01 - detailed outlier list: dim 1 d-days; shows every single outlier remaining in the boxplot after bathroom filtering

## Prepapre data

```{r}
p01_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P01")

lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
light_condition_P01 <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

lab_dates <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> unique() |> sort()

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(Date = lab_dates, Condition = light_condition_P01[1:length(lab_dates)])

# === GET DIM 1 D-DAYS DATA (AFTER BATHROOM FILTERING) ===

dim1_d_days <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Datetime),
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60
  ) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  filter(
    Condition == "D",
    hour_dec >= 18.5,
    hour_dec < 21.5
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    in_bathroom = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p01_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p01_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  ) |> 
  filter(!in_bathroom)  # EXCLUDE bathroom breaks

cat("=== DIM 1 D-DAYS DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total data points (after bathroom filtering):", nrow(dim1_d_days), "\n\n")
```

## Calculate outlier threshold

```{r}
q1 <- quantile(dim1_d_days$MEDI, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- quantile(dim1_d_days$MEDI, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
iqr <- q3 - q1
upper_fence <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
lower_fence <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
```

## Identify all outliers

```{r}
outliers <- dim1_d_days |> 
  filter(MEDI > upper_fence | MEDI < lower_fence) |> 
  select(Date, Datetime, MEDI, hour_dec) |> 
  arrange(desc(MEDI)) |> 
  mutate(
    outlier_type = case_when(
      MEDI > upper_fence ~ "Upper",
      MEDI < lower_fence ~ "Lower",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

## Detailed outlier list

```{r}
outliers_display <- outliers |> 
  mutate(
    Date_formatted = format(Date, "%Y-%m-%d (%a)"),
    Time = format(Datetime, "%H:%M:%S"),
    MEDI_rounded = round(MEDI, 2),
    Hour_decimal = round(hour_dec, 2)
  ) |> 
  select(Date_formatted, Time, MEDI_rounded, Hour_decimal, outlier_type) |> 
  rename(
    "Date" = Date_formatted,
    "Time" = Time,
    "Light (lx)" = MEDI_rounded,
    "Hour (decimal)" = Hour_decimal,
    "Type" = outlier_type
  )

print(as.data.frame(outliers_display), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Outliers grouped by date - with individual times

```{r}
outliers_by_date_detailed <- outliers |> 
  arrange(Date, Datetime) |> 
  mutate(
    Date_formatted = format(Date, "%Y-%m-%d (%a)"),
    Time = format(Datetime, "%H:%M:%S"),
    MEDI_rounded = round(MEDI, 2)
  ) |> 
  group_by(Date_formatted) |> 
  summarise(
    n_outliers = n(),
    times = paste(Time, collapse = ", "),
    lux_values = paste(MEDI_rounded, collapse = ", "),
    min_lux = round(min(MEDI), 2),
    mean_lux = round(mean(MEDI), 2),
    max_lux = round(max(MEDI), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(max_lux))

print(as.data.frame(outliers_by_date_detailed %>% select(Date_formatted, n_outliers, min_lux, mean_lux, max_lux)), row.names = FALSE)

for (i in 1:nrow(outliers_by_date_detailed)) {
  cat("\n", outliers_by_date_detailed$Date_formatted[i], "- Total:", outliers_by_date_detailed$n_outliers[i], "outliers\n")
  cat("Times:      ", outliers_by_date_detailed$times[i], "\n")
  cat("Lux values: ", outliers_by_date_detailed$lux_values[i], "\n")
}
```

# P02 - multi-panel plot: in-chamber light exposure

## Step 1: get bathroom breaks from central dataframe (P02)

```{r}
p02_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% 
  filter(participant_id == "P02")
```

## Step 2: prepare lab data with conditions (P02)

```{r}
# Laboratory period for P02 (same as P01)
lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Light condition sequence (11 days: 6 D, 5 B)
light_condition_P02 <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

# Get lab dates
lab_dates <- light_P02 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> unique() |> sort()

# Create condition lookup
lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
  Date = lab_dates, 
  Condition = light_condition_P02[1:length(lab_dates)]
)
```

## Step 3: process all lab data (P02)

```{r}
all_lab_data <- light_P02 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Datetime),
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60
  ) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    Day_label = paste0(format(Date, "%b %d"), " (", Condition, ")"),
    Day_label = factor(Day_label, levels = unique(Day_label)),
    in_bathroom = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p02_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p02_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## Step 4: prepare chamber data with hours prior to HBT (P02)

```{r}
# P02 Chamber timing (HBT 00:00, same as P01):
# Entry: 18:30 (HBT-5.5h)
# Dim 1: 18:30-21:30 (3h)
# Bright: 21:30-23:00 (1.5h)
# Dim 2: 23:00-23:30 (0.5h)
# Exit: 23:30 (HBT-0.5h)

chamber_data <- all_lab_data |> 
  filter(hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 23.5) |> 
  mutate(hours_prior_HBT = hour_dec - 24)  # 0 = HBT

# Bright days only for vertical lines
bright_lines <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B") |> 
  distinct(Day_label) |> 
  mutate(
    xintercept_start = 21.5 - 24,  # Bright phase start relative to HBT
    xintercept_end   = 23 - 24     # Bright phase end relative to HBT
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(xintercept_start, xintercept_end),
    names_to = "phase", 
    values_to = "xintercept"
  )
```

## Step 5: create multi-panel plot (P02)

```{r}
#| label: fig-actlumus-inchamber-p02
#| fig-cap: "In-chamber light exposure: all laboratory days - P02"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9

# Create evening labels matching melatonin style
chamber_data_plot <- chamber_data %>%
  mutate(
    day_index = as.integer(factor(Day_label, levels = unique(Day_label))),
    light_cond = str_extract(Day_label, "(?<=\\()[BD](?=\\))"),
    evening_label = paste0("Evening ", day_index, " (", light_cond, ")")
  )

ggplot(chamber_data_plot, aes(x = hours_prior_HBT, y = MEDI + 1)) +
  
  # Bathroom shading
  geom_rect(
    data = chamber_data_plot |> filter(in_bathroom),
    aes(
      xmin = hours_prior_HBT - 0.017,
      xmax = hours_prior_HBT + 0.017,
      ymin = 1,
      ymax = 1000
    ),
    fill = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Bright-phase vertical lines only for bright days
  geom_vline(
    data = bright_lines,
    aes(xintercept = xintercept),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Light exposure line
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Facet by evening label
  facet_wrap(~evening_label, ncol = 4) +
  
  # X-axis in full hours prior HBT
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-6, 0, by = 1)
  ) +
  
  # Y-axis log scale up to 1000
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000),
    labels = scales::comma,
    limits = c(1, 1000),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "In-chamber light exposure: all laboratory days",
    subtitle = "P02 | 11 days (6 D, 5 B) | Gray shading: bathroom breaks | Dashed lines: bright phase",
    x = "Hours prior to HBT",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Step 6: boxplot - light exposure distribution by chamber phase (P02)

```{r}
# Prepare data for boxplot (raw minute-by-minute data)
phase_data <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(in_bathroom == FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 18.5 & hour_dec < 21.5 ~ "Dim 1",
      hour_dec >= 21.5 & hour_dec < 23.0 ~ "Intervention",
      hour_dec >= 23.0 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Dim 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(phase))

# Bathroom break data
bathroom_data <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(in_bathroom == TRUE) |>
  mutate(phase = "Bathroom")

# Combine all data
combined_data <- bind_rows(phase_data, bathroom_data) |> 
  mutate(
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Dim 1", "Intervention", "Dim 2", "Bathroom")),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("D", "B"))
  )

# Define colors
light_colors <- c("D" = "#4A90E2", "B" = "#F5A623")

# Create boxplot
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = phase, y = MEDI + 1, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = light_colors,
    labels = c("D" = "D days", "B" = "B days")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Light exposure distribution by chamber phase",
    subtitle = "P02 | 11 days (6 D, 5 B) | Minute-by-minute raw data | Bathroom breaks shown separately",
    x = "Chamber phase",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)",
    fill = "Condition",
    caption = "Dim 1: 3h 10lx | Intervention: 1.5h | Dim 2: 0.5h 10lx | Bathroom: during breaks only"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top", 
    aspect.ratio = 1  
  )
```

# P07 - multi-panel plot: in-chamber light exposure

## Step 1: get bathroom breaks from central dataframe (P07)

```{r}
p07_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% 
  filter(participant_id == "P07")
```

## Step 2: prepare lab data with conditions (P07)

```{r}
# Laboratory period for P07
lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-07-28 07:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-08-07 07:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")

# Light condition sequence (10 days: 5 D, 5 B)
light_condition_P07 <- c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

# Get lab dates
lab_dates <- light_P07 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> unique() |> sort()

# Create condition lookup
lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
  Date = lab_dates, 
  Condition = light_condition_P07[1:length(lab_dates)]
)
```

## Step 3: prcoess all lab data (P07)

```{r}
all_lab_data <- light_P07 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Datetime),
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60
  ) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  mutate(
    Day_label = paste0(format(Date, "%b %d"), " (", Condition, ")"),
    Day_label = factor(Day_label, levels = unique(Day_label)),
    in_bathroom = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p07_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p07_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )
```

## Step 4: prepare chamber data with hours prior to HBT (P07)

```{r}
# P07 Chamber timing (HBT 23:30):
# Entry: 18:00 (HBT-5.5h)
# Dim 1: 18:00-21:00 (3h)
# Bright: 21:00-22:30 (1.5h)
# Dim 2: 22:30-23:00 (0.5h)
# Exit: 23:00 (HBT-0.5h)

chamber_data <- all_lab_data |> 
  filter(hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 23) |> 
  mutate(hours_prior_HBT = hour_dec - 23.5)  # 0 = HBT at 23:30

# Bright days only for vertical lines
bright_lines <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(Condition == "B") |> 
  distinct(Day_label) |> 
  mutate(
    xintercept_start = 21 - 23.5,    # Bright phase start relative to HBT
    xintercept_end   = 22.5 - 23.5   # Bright phase end relative to HBT
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(xintercept_start, xintercept_end),
    names_to = "phase", 
    values_to = "xintercept"
  )
```

## Step 5: create multi-panel plot (P07)

```{r}
#| label: fig-actlumus-inchamber-p07
#| fig-cap: "In-chamber light exposure: all laboratory days - P07"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9

# Create evening labels matching melatonin style
chamber_data_plot <- chamber_data %>%
  mutate(
    day_index = as.integer(factor(Day_label, levels = unique(Day_label))),
    light_cond = str_extract(Day_label, "(?<=\\()[BD](?=\\))"),
    evening_label = paste0("Evening ", day_index, " (", light_cond, ")")
  )

ggplot(chamber_data_plot, aes(x = hours_prior_HBT, y = MEDI + 1)) +
  
  # Bathroom shading
  geom_rect(
    data = chamber_data_plot |> filter(in_bathroom),
    aes(
      xmin = hours_prior_HBT - 0.017,
      xmax = hours_prior_HBT + 0.017,
      ymin = 1,
      ymax = 1000
    ),
    fill = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Bright-phase vertical lines only for bright days
  geom_vline(
    data = bright_lines,
    aes(xintercept = xintercept),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Light exposure line
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Facet by evening label
  facet_wrap(~evening_label, ncol = 4) +
  
  # X-axis in full hours prior HBT
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-6, 0, by = 1)
  ) +
  
  # Y-axis log scale up to 1000
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000),
    labels = scales::comma,
    limits = c(1, 1000),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "In-chamber light exposure: all laboratory days",
    subtitle = "P07 | 10 days (5 D, 5 B) | Gray shading: bathroom breaks | Dashed lines: bright phase",
    x = "Hours prior to HBT",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Step 6: boxplot - light exposure distribution by chamber phase (P07)

```{r}
# Prepare data for boxplot (raw minute-by-minute data)
phase_data <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(in_bathroom == FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 18.0 & hour_dec < 21.0 ~ "Dim 1",
      hour_dec >= 21.0 & hour_dec < 22.5 ~ "Intervention",
      hour_dec >= 22.5 & hour_dec < 23.0 ~ "Dim 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(phase))

# Bathroom break data
bathroom_data <- chamber_data |> 
  filter(in_bathroom == TRUE) |>
  mutate(phase = "Bathroom")

# Combine all data
combined_data <- bind_rows(phase_data, bathroom_data) |> 
  mutate(
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Dim 1", "Intervention", "Dim 2", "Bathroom")),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("D", "B"))
  )

# Define colors
light_colors <- c("D" = "#4A90E2", "B" = "#F5A623")

# Create boxplot
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = phase, y = MEDI + 1, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = light_colors,
    labels = c("D" = "D days", "B" = "B days")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Light exposure distribution by chamber phase",
    subtitle = "P07 | 10 days (5 D, 5 B) | Minute-by-minute raw data | Bathroom breaks shown separately",
    x = "Chamber phase",
    y = "Melanopic EDI (lx, log scale)",
    fill = "Condition",
    caption = "Dim 1: 3h 10lx | Intervention: 1.5h | Dim 2: 0.5h 10lx | Bathroom: during breaks only"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top", 
    aspect.ratio = 1  
  )
```

# Grand Average Boxplot Light Exposure for each sub-phase (dim vs. bright days)

Participant-level boxplot: All participants

Each participant contributes one aggregated value per phase / condition

Shows between-participant variability

## Function: process participant data and aggregate

```{r}
process_participant_aggregated <- function(participant_id, light_data, lab_start, lab_end, 
                                           light_sequence, chamber_start, chamber_end) {
  
  # Get bathroom breaks for this participant
  p_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% 
    filter(participant_id == !!participant_id)
  
  # Get lab dates
  lab_dates <- light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
    pull(Date) |> unique() |> sort()
  
  # Create condition lookup
  lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(
    Date = lab_dates, 
    Condition = light_sequence[1:length(lab_dates)]
  )
  
  # Process data
  all_lab_data <- light_data |> 
    filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
    mutate(
      Date = as.Date(Datetime),
      hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60
    ) |> 
    left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
    mutate(
      in_bathroom = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
        any(dt >= p_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p_bathroom$end_datetime)
      })
    )
  
  # Filter for chamber time
  chamber_data <- all_lab_data |> 
    filter(hour_dec >= chamber_start, hour_dec < chamber_end)
  
  # Calculate phase boundaries
  dim1_end <- chamber_start + 3
  bright_end <- dim1_end + 1.5
  dim2_end <- chamber_end
  
  # Categorize by phase (exclude bathroom breaks from chamber phases)
  phase_data <- chamber_data |> 
    filter(in_bathroom == FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      phase = case_when(
        hour_dec >= chamber_start & hour_dec < dim1_end ~ "Dim 1",
        hour_dec >= dim1_end & hour_dec < bright_end ~ "Intervention",
        hour_dec >= bright_end & hour_dec < dim2_end ~ "Dim 2",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) |> 
    filter(!is.na(phase))
  
  # Bathroom data (separate)
  bathroom_data <- chamber_data |>
    filter(in_bathroom == TRUE) |>
    mutate(phase = "Bathroom")
  
  # Combine phase and bathroom data
  combined_data <- bind_rows(phase_data, bathroom_data)
  
  # Aggregate: Calculate mean for each phase and condition
  aggregated_stats <- combined_data |>
    group_by(Condition, phase) |>
    summarise(
      mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_points = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(participant = participant_id)
  
  return(aggregated_stats)
}
```

### Check data distribution

```{r}
# Show the absolute differences in light exposure during the wake pahse 
diff_mean
diff_median
diff_median_log
diff_time_above_10lx
diff_time_above_250lx 

# Test normality of differences
# Shapiro-Wilk tests for all differences
shapiro_mean <- shapiro.test(diff_mean)
shapiro_median <- shapiro.test(diff_median)
shapiro_median_log <- shapiro.test(diff_median_log)
shapiro_time10 <- shapiro.test(diff_time_above_10lx)
shapiro_time250 <- shapiro.test(diff_time_above_250lx)

# Summary of normality tests
normality_results <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Mean Lux", "Median Lux", "Median Log₁₀(lx)", 
             "Time >10 lx (h/day)", "Time >250 lx (h/day)"),
  
  Shapiro_W = c(
    shapiro_mean$statistic,
    shapiro_median$statistic,
    shapiro_median_log$statistic,
    shapiro_time10$statistic,
    shapiro_time250$statistic
  ),
  
  Shapiro_p = c(
    shapiro_mean$p.value,
    shapiro_median$p.value,
    shapiro_median_log$p.value,
    shapiro_time10$p.value,
    shapiro_time250$p.value
  ),
  
  Normal = ifelse(Shapiro_p > 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
  Test_to_use = ifelse(Shapiro_p > 0.05, "Paired t-test", "Wilcoxon")
)

normality_results
```

### Test whether there is a difference between D and B laboratory days

```{r}
# Mean Lux (not normal → Wilcoxon)
test_mean <- wilcox.test(dim_wake_mean, bright_wake_mean, paired = TRUE)

# Median Lux (not normal → Wilcoxon)
test_median <- wilcox.test(dim_wake_median, bright_wake_median, paired = TRUE)

# Median Log Lux (normal → t-test)
test_median_log <- t.test(dim_wake_median_log, bright_wake_median_log, paired = TRUE)

# Time above 10 lx (normal → t-test)
test_time10 <- t.test(time_above_10lx_labdim_wake, time_above_10lx_labbright, paired = TRUE)

# Time above 250 lx (not normal → Wilcoxon)
test_time250 <- wilcox.test(time_above_250lx_labdim_wake, time_above_250lx_labbright_wake, paired = TRUE)

### Print the test results 
print(test_mean)
print(test_median)
print(test_median_log)
print(test_time10)
print(test_time250)
```

## Analyze last 30 minutes of chamber dim 2 phase - corrected

For P06, P07, P09: Light exposure in final 30 min of each Bright day Important: Uses participant-specific lab_data objects

## P06 - last 30 minutes of chamber dim 2

```{r}
cat("=== P06 - LAST 30 MIN OF CHAMBER DIM 2 (BRIGHT DAYS) ===\n\n")

# Re-create P06 lab_data with unique name
lab_data_P06 <- light_P06 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= ymd_hm("2025-07-28 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin"), 
         Datetime <= ymd_hm("2025-08-07 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  left_join(
    tibble(
      Date = seq(as.Date("2025-07-28"), as.Date("2025-08-06"), by = "day"),
      Condition = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")
    ),
    by = "Date"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60,
    Subphase = case_when(
      hour_dec >= 23.5 | hour_dec < 8.5 ~ "Sleep",
      hour_dec >= 8.5 & hour_dec < 17 ~ "Wake (Outside Lab)",
      hour_dec >= 17 & hour_dec < 18 ~ "Lab (Outside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Lab (Inside Chamber)",
      hour_dec >= 23 & hour_dec < 23.5 ~ "Commute",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chamber_Phase = case_when(
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 18 & hour_dec < 21 ~ "Chamber Dim 1",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 21 & hour_dec < 22.5 ~ "Chamber Bright",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "B" & hour_dec >= 22.5 & hour_dec < 23 ~ "Chamber Dim 2",
      Subphase == "Lab (Inside Chamber)" & Condition == "D" ~ "Chamber Dim (Full)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    is_bathroom_break = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      p06_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P06")
      any(dt >= p06_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p06_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  )

p06_dim2_last30 <- lab_data_P06 |> 
  filter(
    Condition == "B",
    !is_bathroom_break,
    Chamber_Phase == "Chamber Dim 2"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  group_by(Date) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_lux = mean(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lux = median(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_lux = min(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lux = max(MEDI, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_minutes = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  arrange(Date)

print(p06_dim2_last30)

cat("\nP06 Summary (last 30 min of Chamber Dim 2):\n")
cat("Mean across all bright days:", round(mean(p06_dim2_last30$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "lx\n")
cat("SD:", round(sd(p06_dim2_last30$mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "lx\n")
cat("Number of bright days analyzed:", nrow(p06_dim2_last30), "\n\n")
```

## P01 - debug bathroom break filtering

Find why bathroom breaks are not being excluded properly

### Setup

```{r}
p01_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P01")

lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
light_condition_P01 <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

lab_dates <- light_P01 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> unique() |> sort()

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(Date = lab_dates, Condition = light_condition_P01[1:length(lab_dates)])

cat("=== D-DAYS FOR P01 ===\n")
d_days <- lab_condition_lookup %>% filter(Condition == "D")
print(d_days)

# === CHECK BATHROOM BREAKS ON D-DAYS ===

cat("\n=== BATHROOM BREAKS ON D-DAYS ===\n")

bathroom_on_d_days <- p01_bathroom %>% 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(start_datetime)) %>% 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") %>% 
  filter(Condition == "D") %>% 
  mutate(
    start_hour = hour(start_datetime) + minute(start_datetime)/60,
    end_hour = hour(end_datetime) + minute(end_datetime)/60,
    in_dim1 = (start_hour >= 18.5 & start_hour < 21.5) | (end_hour > 18.5 & end_hour <= 21.5)
  )

print(bathroom_on_d_days)

cat("\n=== BATHROOM BREAKS IN DIM 1 ON D-DAYS ===\n")
dim1_breaks <- bathroom_on_d_days %>% filter(in_dim1)
print(dim1_breaks)
```

## P02 - detailed outlier list: intervention d-days

## Preapre data

```{r}
p02_bathroom <- bathroom_breaks %>% filter(participant_id == "P02")

lab_start <- ymd_hm("2025-06-16 08:31", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
lab_end <- ymd_hm("2025-06-27 08:30", tz = "Europe/Berlin")
light_condition_P02 <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")

lab_dates <- light_P02 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) |> 
  pull(Date) |> unique() |> sort()

lab_condition_lookup <- tibble(Date = lab_dates, Condition = light_condition_P02[1:length(lab_dates)])

# === GET INTERVENTION D-DAYS DATA (AFTER BATHROOM FILTERING) ===

intervention_d_days <- light_P02 |> 
  filter(Datetime >= lab_start, Datetime <= lab_end) |> 
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Datetime),
    hour_dec = hour(Datetime) + minute(Datetime)/60
  ) |> 
  left_join(lab_condition_lookup, by = "Date") |> 
  filter(
    Condition == "D",
    hour_dec >= 21.5,  # Intervention phase: 21:30-23:00
    hour_dec < 23.0
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    in_bathroom = pmap_lgl(list(Datetime), function(dt) {
      any(dt >= p02_bathroom$start_datetime & dt <= p02_bathroom$end_datetime)
    })
  ) |> 
  filter(!in_bathroom)  # EXCLUDE bathroom breaks

cat("=== INTERVENTION D-DAYS DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total data points (after bathroom filtering):", nrow(intervention_d_days), "\n\n")
```

## Calculate outlier threshold

```{r}
q1 <- quantile(intervention_d_days$MEDI, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- quantile(intervention_d_days$MEDI, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
iqr <- q3 - q1
upper_fence <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
lower_fence <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr

cat("=== BOXPLOT STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Q1 (25th percentile):", round(q1, 2), "lx\n")
cat("Median (50th percentile):", round(median(intervention_d_days$MEDI), 2), "lx\n")
cat("Q3 (75th percentile):", round(q3, 2), "lx\n")
cat("IQR:", round(iqr, 2), "lx\n")
cat("Lower fence (Q1 - 1.5*IQR):", round(lower_fence, 2), "lx\n")
cat("Upper fence (Q3 + 1.5*IQR):", round(upper_fence, 2), "lx\n\n")
```

## Identify all outliers

```{r}
outliers <- intervention_d_days |> 
  filter(MEDI > upper_fence | MEDI < lower_fence) |> 
  select(Date, Datetime, MEDI, hour_dec) |> 
  arrange(desc(MEDI)) |> 
  mutate(
    outlier_type = case_when(
      MEDI > upper_fence ~ "Upper",
      MEDI < lower_fence ~ "Lower",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cat("=== TOTAL OUTLIERS ===\n")
cat("Upper outliers (above", round(upper_fence, 2), "lx):", sum(outliers$MEDI > upper_fence), "\n")
cat("Lower outliers (below", round(lower_fence, 2), "lx):", sum(outliers$MEDI < lower_fence), "\n")
cat("Total outliers:", nrow(outliers), "\n\n")
```

```{r}
outliers_above_10 <- outliers |>
```
